339-677-955-3899.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2073-3967-7876-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Consulate Dreadnought from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Consulate Dreadnought enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Consulate Dreadnought to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Consulate Dreadnought.
When Consulate Dreadnought dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1090-5998-6867-7055.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

3110-3532-5078-7737.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it's attached to
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2173-2469-4063-5220.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Fleshtaker trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1123-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
1123-5256-6972.notes: If Flayer of the Hatebound starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

1402-2218-4763-5295.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1482-4195-4316-4574.description:
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Jeweled Lotus from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2781-6132-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Felidar Guardian.
2781-6132-6797.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2558-5687-5689-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Raiders' Spoils, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

2661-3692-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one artifact.
2661-3692-6747.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Aethersnipe for its evoke cost by paying {U}{U}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
When Aethersnipe enters the battlefield, its first ability and evoke ability trigger.
Resolve the first Aethersnipe trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Aethersnipe trigger, failing to sacrifice it as it is no longer on the battlefield.
Repeat.

238-2921-5756.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Gerrard.
When Gerrard dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning up to one legendary creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Havi.
When Havi dies, it triggers, returning Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gerrard trigger from step 2, failing to exile it as it is no longer in your graveyard and returning Havi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.

1251-3259-5659.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-3259-5659.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Disa the Restless's second ability.
Resolve the Disa the Restless trigger, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Tarmogoyf token, then causing untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4789-6191.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4789-6191.description:
Gain life.
Cliffhaven Vampire triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent that lost life.
Resolve a Bloodthirsty Conqueror trigger, gaining 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2304-3019-4377-4872-5546.notablePrerequisites:
You have not cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
Time Warp and Walk the Aeons exiled by Arcane Bombardment.
2304-3019-4377-4872-5546.description:
Cast Inspiring Refrain by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Arcane Bombardment triggers, exiling a random instant or sorcery from your graveyard, and then casting a copy of Time Warp and Walk the Aeons without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the Time Warp and Walk the Aeons copies, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain, causing you to draw two cards and exile Inspiring Refrain with three time counters on it.
Activate Jhoira's Timebug by tapping it, removing a time counter from Inspiring Refrain.
Move to your first extra turn, removing a time counter from Inspiring Refrain during your upkeep.
Move to your second extra turn, removing a time counter from Inspiring Refrain during your upkeep.
Inspiring Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

643-1636-3789.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
643-1636-3789.description:
Activate The Blackstaff of Waterdeep by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, causing Maskwood Nexus to become an artifact creature.
Activate any number of mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Maskwood Nexus by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a 2/2 Shapeshifter creature token.
When the Shapeshifter enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1525-2031-2406-2660-5361.notablePrerequisites:
Auton Soldier is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
1525-2031-2406-2660-5361.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
1525-2031-2406-2660-5361.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

132-198-1379-4687.notablePrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-198-1379-4687.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Myr Welder and adding {G} or {U} for each charge counter on Myr Welder.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.

2034-3996-4720.notablePrerequisites: Twilight Drover has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-3996-4720.description:
Activate Twilight Drover by paying {2}{W} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Spirit tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Spirits die, Twilight Drover triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Twilight Drover.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1636-4415.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1636-4415.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Stonecloaker by paying {2}{U}.
Stonecloaker enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm and Stonecloaker.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm's trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Resolve the Stonecloaker's trigger, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

3094-4821.notablePrerequisites: Nonland mana sources that can tap for at least {4} on the battlefield.
3094-4821.description:
Cast Dramatic Reversal, holding priority.
Tap Lithoform Engine and spend {3} to activate the second ability of Lithoform Engine, copying Dramatic Reversal.
Allow the Dramatic Reversal copy to resolve, untapping your nonland permanents.
Tap your nonland mana sources for at least {4}.
Repeat steps 2-4 for an infinite loop.

38-345-586-618-1657-1799-3189.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
38-345-586-618-1657-1799-3189.description:
Cast Doomsday by paying {B}{B}{B}, searching your library and graveyard for Metallic Mimic, Murderous Redcap, Skirk Prospector, Kiki-Jiki, and Priest of Gix, exiling all other cards from your graveyard and library, and then placing the remaining cards on top of your library in the order previously listed and losing half your life, rounded up.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Priest of Gix into your graveyard and then onto the battlefield, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Kiki-Jiki into your graveyard and then onto the battlefield.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping, creating a token copy of Priest of Gix.
Token copy of Priest of Gix entering the battlefield, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Skirk Prospector into your graveyard and then onto the battlefield.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Murderous Redcap into your graveyard and then onto the battlefield, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki and Murderous Redcap, adding {R}{R}.
Murderous Redcap persist ability triggers, holding priority, activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Metallic Mimic into your graveyard and then onto the battlefield, naming "Goblin".
Resolve the Murderous Redcap persist ability, returning it to the battlefield, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Murderous Redcap, adding {R}.
Murderous Redcap persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat from step 11.
